Crime & Law · India

Protests over exam paper leaks see police action, political debate

Protests erupted in Delhi concerning alleged exam paper leaks, with participants including young individuals seeking a better future. Reports indicate police action against protesters, with some accounts describing lathi-charges and alleged police brutality. Politicians have commented on the situation, with one referencing past police actions and another discussing the system's perceived betrayal of students. The government has announced the establishment of fast-track courts to address paper leak cases.
